title: Adyen - Confusing fee structure and charges on inactive gateways
clean_text: G2 reviewers report excessive and confusing fees, including monthly charges that continue even when a gateway is inactive, and fee increases that make it harder to track final transaction amounts during pre-authorization. Reviewers describe Adyen's premium pricing as not always clear upfront, and note it can be expensive and a poor fit for businesses that do not process a large volume of transactions. Getting the most value out of the platform is described as challenging and time-consuming without a dedicated technical team, and some users report bugs that required custom fixes during implementation.
